description: Calculate the PBE band gap of bulk wurtzite GaN.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of bulk GaN (wurtzite structure, P6_3mc) and report its value in eV.

references: Onen, Kecik, Durgun & Ciraci, Phys. Rev. B 93, 085431 (2016)
Kecik et al., Appl. Phys. Rev. 5, 011105 (2018)
method.modeling: Use bulk wurtzite GaN in the P6_3mc structure and report the direct Gamma-point fundamental band gap.
method.rationale: The scored value is the 1.71 eV PBE direct gap tabulated for 3D wurtzite GaN by Kecik et al. from the Onen et al. calculations. This replaces the older Tran-Blaha citation, whose tabulated GaN entry is zinc-blende/LDA rather than wurtzite/PBE. Wright and Nelson support the explicit Ga 3d-valence treatment, which lowers GaN gaps relative to frozen-3d pseudopotential calculations; the wider absolute tolerance covers this POTCAR sensitivity and ordinary k-point/geometry convergence.
